scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE, earnings versus cash: two tall navy-outlined bars standing side by side on one baseline, drawn EXACTLY THE SAME HEIGHT (their tops level with each other, the second one only a hair shorter), because the interest almost wipes out the earnings: the first teal bar labelled OPERATING EARNINGS $460M, the second ochre bar labelled INTEREST $457M. To their right, a large glass jar standing on the same baseline, completely empty except for a few coins' worth of dust at the bottom, labelled OPERATING CASH ≈ $0.

MIDDLE ZONE, the supplier squeeze, drawn top to bottom: at the top a row of five delivery trucks loaded with toy boxes and teddy bears; two of them have a raised navy hand-stop sign, with one label over the row: NEARLY 40% OF SUPPLIERS. A downward arrow leads to a hand handing banknotes across a counter to a supplier while the toy boxes are still sealed and unsold (no cash register, no screens), labelled PAY BEFORE STOCK SELLS. A downward arrow leads to a plain ochre sack with no symbol on it, being pulled away by a hand, labelled CASH NEED > $1BN. At the bottom of the middle zone, two side-by-side boxes contrast two clocks. Left box: a ringing alarm clock next to a stack of toy boxes; under the left box the single label STOCK DUE NOW. Right box: a laptop showing a shopping cart and a circular subscription-loop arrow, next to a slow sand hourglass; above the right box the single label TECH PLAN $90.4M and under it the single label PAYOFF IN YEARS. The label TECH PLAN $90.4M appears only once in the whole image.

RIGHT ZONE, a short vertical timeline of two milestones joined by a line going downward: first a courthouse with columns labelled SEPT 2017: CHAPTER 11; then a shop front with a striped awning, shutters pulled down and a completely blank signboard with no letters, labelled MARCH 2018: US STORES CLOSE; below it a crowd of small employee figures labelled 33,000 JOBS.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: OPERATING EARNINGS $460M, INTEREST $457M, OPERATING CASH ≈ $0, NEARLY 40% OF SUPPLIERS, PAY BEFORE STOCK SELLS, CASH NEED > $1BN, STOCK DUE NOW, TECH PLAN $90.4M, PAYOFF IN YEARS, SEPT 2017: CHAPTER 11, MARCH 2018: US STORES CLOSE, 33,000 JOBS. The shop signboard is blank; no words, currency symbols or letters on the sack, trucks, boxes, signs or screens. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Operating earnings of $460 million stand beside interest of $457 million, and an empty jar marks operating cash of about zero; nearly 40% of suppliers demand payment before the stock sells, raising the cash need above $1 billion, while stock is due now and a $90.4 million technology plan pays off in years; a timeline runs from Chapter 11 in September 2017 to closing the US stores in March 2018, with 33,000 jobs affected.
caption: Earnings covered the interest but produced no cash; when suppliers wanted paying first, stock due now crowded out a technology plan that paid off in years.
